claims.status_at_long_protocol: Unsupported extension of the exact completion theorem; no counterexample observed yet in the initial completed mixed cases.

claims.claim: Rank-one character availability predicts learning within2000 updates.
claims.status: The2000-update learning implication is falsified by verified source-model division endpoints. Late discovery does not repair the claimed short-budget guarantee.
claims.premises_to_audit: Check faithful characters, connected nonzero-input observation graphs, perfect matchings and source checkpoint replay. Prime changes also change the number of training pairs; do not call this a single-variable causal effect of prime.
claims.correction: Separate recoverability under an ideal objective from optimizer discovery and data/parameter scaling. The long phase tests whether delayed grokking accounts for the early difference.
claims.status_at_long_protocol: Early candidate counterexample: P97 wide division ends at4.725%, P193 wide division at100%, with the same width/depth/optimizer/update budget and rank-one character availability.
claims.premise_audit: Faithful character kernels checked; every declared nonzero-input division observation graph has connectedness and perfect-matching witnesses in recovery_patterns.json. All early and long final success classifications reproduce.
claims.final_scope: All four long division pairs reach100% at100000 updates with unchanged full optimizer/sampler states. Ideal recovery is distinct from sampled CE/Schedule-Free discovery time.

claims.claim: Task spectrum alone predicts benefits from width or depth.
claims.status: Unchanged task spectra coexist with large differences in finite-horizon discovery times: P97 wide/deep first99 at12500/27500, P193 at750/12250.
claims.counterexample_criterion: Different reproducible learning outcomes for matched task/splits with identical task spectrum; report approximate parameter matching, head dimensions and actual compute.
claims.correction_if_found: Include architecture-specific routing/composition and training dynamics; no necessary-depth theorem follows from these finite runs.
claims.status_at_long_protocol: Exploratory comparison; no depth advantage asserted from the currently completed cases.
claims.final_scope: All four end at100%; approximate parameter matching changes head dimension and compute too. This rejects a spectrum-only timing account, not a necessary-depth or isolated causal depth claim.

claims.claim: An early memorization plateau is permanent failure.
claims.status: Falsified: three failing2000-update division states later exceed99% without changing model, split, optimizer recipe or sampler state.
claims.counterexample_criterion: A fixed full-state continuation crosses99% heldout accuracy after the2000-update screen, with no change to model/task/optimizer recipe.
claims.correction_if_found: Reject finite-horizon impossibility inferences; record transition time, epochs and any later relapse.
claims.status_at_long_protocol: Unjustified before the long grokking phase.
claims.final_scope: P97 deep relapses below99% at30000 and returns at32000; every curve and the100000-update endpoint is retained. All10 continuations complete within6283.38 seconds of the7200-second cap.

formalization_rule: If an actual Lean statement is false, identify its precise hypothesis/definition mismatch and correct it with a counterexample. Do not weaken valid spectral theorems to fit outcomes.

additional_exploratory_findings.claim: Exact real-equivalent forward formulas automatically have equally accurate FP32 shared-parameter gradients.
additional_exploratory_findings.status: Rejected by the actual deep XSA checkpoint audit: centering-only forward is accurate but parameter-gradient RMS error reaches2.284 versus FP64.
additional_exploratory_findings.correction: Preserve clipped projection semantics and share a guarded constant-prefix path.17 Lean theorems prove exact algebra/source-state/readout equalities, including arbitrary finite depth and rotary phases. Numerical accuracy is independently measured, not inferred from real equality.
additional_exploratory_findings.scope: No uniform floating-point bound, independent-input derivative equivalence, or improved learning guarantee is claimed.

additional_exploratory_findings.claim: Bounded normalized Q/K scores guarantee query trainability from any scale.
additional_exploratory_findings.status: Rejected as a finite-budget inference by the known-solution synthetic probe: normalized queries at RMS1e6 have tiny gradients and fail all3 declared data seeds, while unit-scale queries learn all3.
additional_exploratory_findings.correction: Keep proved score/sensitivity upper bounds. Specify query initialization/scale and optimizer dynamics; no gradient lower bound or convergence theorem follows.
additional_exploratory_findings.scope: Query-only toy with fixed initial direction and varying data/minibatch seeds; no full-transformer residual-architecture conclusion.
